summary: Dirt biker clipped a rock on Death Pass and fell to the river/ravine bottom; witnessing mountain bikers pulled him out; Crested Butte SAR, Crested Butte Fire Protection District, Mt. Crested Butte Police and CareFlight did a technical rope raise and flew him to hospital.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Crested Butte Fire Protection District; Mt. Crested Butte Police Department; CareFlight
